verdict.rationale:
Docs confirm a hybrid search mode (`searchMode: "hybrid"`) and containerTag-based scoping/filtering, plus multiple retrieval paths (document RAG, graph traversal, user profile) that let a developer steer recall beyond a single similarity search. However there is no documented reranking parameter and container tags are a hard namespace boundary rather than flexible metadata filters, so filtering options are narrower than the story implies.
missing for 10: explicit reranking option/parameter, general-purpose metadata filter fields beyond containerTag scoping.
